payload.title: Add tasks sweep-stale command
payload.body:
Add a tasks sweep-stale command that finds task blocks whose Blocked or Blocked by references are already resolved or delivered, and proposes removal (dry run first). Sources: https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/scripts/sweep-stale-task-blocks.mjs and https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/scripts/tasks-md-stale-sweep.mjs (credit only). Related lint rule for DELIVERED reasons already exists.
- **Hypothesis**: a stale-block sweep cuts stale Blocked fields in a queue from the current count to 0 after one run.
- **Measurement**: node packages/cli/dist/cli.js sweep-stale --json | jq length on a fixture queue
- **Success**: reports 100% of seeded stale blocks and 0 false positives on the fixture.
- **Pivot**: if false positives exceed 5% on this repo's real history, keep only the lint rule.
- **Anchor**: Basili, Caldiera, Rombach 1994 (GQM).
